name: Is period correct trim work more expensive than standard trim installation?

mainEntity.name: Is period correct trim work more expensive than standard trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Period correct trim work can often be more expensive than standard trim installation due to several factors. It often requires custom-milled profiles to match historical designs, which increases material and labor costs. Additionally, the installation itself can be more intricate, demanding specialized skills and a keen eye for historical detail. The cost also depends on the type of wood chosen and the overall scope of the project. While it may involve a higher initial investment, the long-term value added to your home's authenticity and aesthetic appeal can be substantial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it can be more expensive due to custom milling, specialized materials, and intricate installation, but it adds significant value.
